text: Hello everyone and welcome to live text coverage of the Premier League clash between West Ham and Manchester City.
The London Stadium plays host to two sides protecting unbeaten starts to the Premier League season.
Man City have won all four of their matches, while West Ham have won three and drawn one of their four games so far.
David Moyes makes a single change from West Ham's win over Luton Town last time out.
Soucek is back after concussion to replace Benrahma, who drops to the bench, while Ward-Prowse and Coufal also start.
Mavropanos could make his debut as a substitute.
Meanwhile, Pep Guardiola makes two changes from the win over Fulham.
Gvardiol and Silva are in for Ake and Kovacic, who joins Kevin De Bruyne, John Stones and Jack Grealish in the treatment room.
New signing Nunes could make his debut from the bench.
City are unbeaten in their last 15 Premier League meetings with West Ham.
The Hammers' only longer streak without victory was a 16-match spell against Manchester United between 1993 and 2001.
The teams make their way out onto the pitch and kick-off is fast approaching at the London Stadium.
The referee blows his whistle and City get us under way.
The reigning champions go straight onto the attack with some neat link-up play down the right.
Walker finds Foden, who centres the ball, but it ricochets kindly into Areola's arms.
Good defending! Walker shows great vision to pick out Haaland, who looks to slip the ball through for Foden.
But Coufal tracks his run well and makes an important sliding intervention.
City continue to ask questions of the West Ham defence.
Doku gets away from Coufal and crosses, but Zouma is well-placed to head clear.
GREAT SAVES! Areola twice comes to West Ham's rescue! Foden's corner finds Rodri, whose powerful header is beaten away by Areola.
A follow-up shot from Haaland is then cleared off the line, before the goalkeeper denies Dias from point-blank range.
West Ham did well to somehow survive that City corner.
The hosts have Areola to thank, but Soucek was also alert in clearing off the line.
The Hammers are enjoying their joint-best start to a Premier League season, having also collected 10 points from their opening four games under Harry Redknapp back in 1999-2000.
It is great to see Guardiola back on the City bench today after his recent back operation.
The Spaniard has never lost against West Ham in the Premier League.
HAALAND MISSES! He is human, you know! Doku teases defenders before slipping the ball through for Gvardiol, who drills it across the face of goal.
Haaland is unmarked at the far post, but can only steer the ball wide from inside the six-yard box.
AGUERD SHOULD SCORE! West Ham force their first corner of the game.
Bowen's delivery is flicked on at the near post by Soucek, but Aguerd cannot react quickly enough to apply the finishing touch in the six-yard box.
Doku has been lively so far.
Receiving a diagonal ball from Akanji, he teases Coufal once more.
The winger then goes for goal from a tight angle, but his shot is straight at Areola.
West Ham have conceded two or more goals in nine of their last 10 Premier League matches against the reigning champions.
But the hosts have maintained their concentration levels so far to keep City at bay.
Foden receives the ball on the edge of the box and gets a shot away, but Zouma is well-placed to deflect it wide for a corner.
City are unbeaten in eight Premier League away games against West Ham, scoring 24 goals along the way and conceding just six.
West Ham threaten and Antonio is found, but Akanji shows great strength to dispossess the Hammers forward.
Sarcastic cheers echo around the London Stadium as Foden's attempted corner curls out of play.
West Ham can relax for a moment with a goal-kick.
Rodri skips away from Edson Alvarez and shoots from the edge of the box.
It is a clean strike, but straight at Areola.
City have dominated proceedings so far with over 70 per cent of the possession.
But the visitors are still in search of the breakthrough.
There is a break in play as Antonio and Dias stay down following an aerial collision.
But after taking a moment to gather themselves, both players are soon back on their feet.
Moyes does not boast a great record against City in recent times.
The Scot claimed 40 of a possible 66 Premier League points from the Citizens during his time at Everton, but has won just two from 39 since then.
WARD-PROWSE!!! 1-0 WEST HAM! The hosts lead against the run of play! West Ham quickly break as Coufal exchanges passes with Bowen and gets away down the right.
The full-back then provides a brilliant cross to the far post, where the unmarked Ward-Prowse buries a header.
Dispossessing Doku, Coufal burst into the action with a neat one-two with Bowen, before his delicious cross was headed home by Ward-Prowse.
Opening the scoring, Ward-Prowse has now been directly involved in a goal in each of his last six Premier League appearances.
That is his best such streak in the English top flight.
Edson Alvarez throws the ball away to prevent City from taking a quick free-kick, and is booked.
There is a long way to go yet at the London Stadium.
But as things stand, West Ham would leapfrog City to second place in the Premier League table.
OFF THE LINE! West Ham somehow survive! Once again, Doku teases Coufal and sends a low cross towards the far post.
Haaland is unmarked and turns the ball towards goal, but Aguerd is alert to prevent it from creeping over the line.
City continue to seek the equaliser.
Rodri lets fly from distance with a fierce effort that whistles fractionally wide of the target.
We are into the first of two additional minutes at the end of this first half.
The visitors keep threatening, but West Ham remain stubborn.
Gvardiol catches Bowen late and has his name taken.
HALF-TIME: WEST HAM 1-0 MANCHESTER CITY
West Ham lead Manchester City 1-0 at the break.
Although on the back foot for most of the first half, the Hammers broke the deadlock in the 36th minute with James Ward-Prowse heading home Vladimir Coufal's cross to continue his rich vein of form.
City trail at the London Stadium despite enjoying 64.1 per cent of the possession during the first half, while also registering 17 shots on goal to their opponents' three.
We are off and running again at the London Stadium.
DOKU!!! 1-1! CITY ARE LEVEL! After a brilliant first half, Doku makes a superb start to the second.
Found by Julian Alvarez, he cuts inside and into the area before sweeping the ball into the far corner.

events.action: sweeping the ball into the far corner

text: Julian Alvarez marauded forward into the West Ham half and played the ball out to Doku, who did the rest in sublime fashion.
What a start to the second half by City! The words of Guardiola are clearly still ringing in their ears.
They are looking incredibly purposeful here.
City force a corner after Foden's shot deflects wide.
The subsequent delivery eventually drops to Gvardiol, who cannot keep his volley down.
The visitors have a free-kick in a dangerous position after Edson Alvarez upends Rodri.
This is a decent opportunity to turn the contest on its head.
OFF THE POST! The woodwork denies City! Julian Alvarez steps up and whips a wonderful effort towards the near corner, only to see his attempt crash against the post.
WHAT A SAVE! Areola denies Haaland! Rodri intercepts possession and drives forward before scooping the ball over the top of the defence for Haaland, whose acrobatic volley is beaten away by Areola.
Still, the goal eludes Haaland today.
City's number nine has now had six shots on goal - more than any other player - without success.
But he will continue to plug away.
West Ham turn defence into attack with Paqueta sending Antonio on his way.
However, the latter's touch is too heavy and Ederson is quickly out to deny him.
City attack down the other end and Rodri tries his luck from distance.
But his left-footed effort is high and wide of the target.
CHANCE! Silva whips a delicious ball into the box.
Haaland attacks it, but can only head straight at Areola.
Great challenge! Emerson leads West Ham's charge with a powerful run into the heart of the City defence.
But Akanji denies him a shot on goal with a brilliantly timed sliding tackle.
GOOD SAVE! Ward-Prowse's corner is met by Zouma, whose powerful header is well kept out by Ederson.
This is a thoroughly entertaining contest at the London Stadium.
Both sides are providing plenty of attacking threat as they go in search of the game's third goal.
GOOD SAVE! Space opens for Gvardiol to let fly from distance.
The full-back's effort takes a slight deflection, but Areola tracks the ball well and pushes it away.
Moyes is going to make a change.
Kudus is introduced for the hosts with Antonio making way.
City make a change as well.
Nunes comes on for his debut in place of Foden.
Benrahma also replaces Edson Alvarez, who is unable to continue after picking up a knock.
We are approaching the final 20 minutes at the London Stadium.
Can either side find a winning goal, or are we set for a stalemate?
West Ham last beat City in the Premier League in September 2015.
The Hammers have every chance of ending that wait here, but must maintain their performance levels.
The Hammers look to threaten down the left flank with Benrahma leading the charge.
But Walker tracks him all the way and eventually snuffs out the danger.
SILVA!!! 2-1 CITY! The turnaround is complete! After Nunes' cross is cleared, City maintain the pressure.
Silva latches onto Julian Alvarez's scooped pass, before clipping the ball beyond Areola.
Julian Alvarez provided the assist with a delightful lofted ball over the top of the West Ham defence.
The reigning champions hit the front at the London Stadium.
It has been quite a battle for Guardiola's side today, but they have eventually edged their noses ahead.
Soucek is late on Akanji and goes into the book.
GREAT SAVE! Walker demonstrates his incredible pace as he beats Zouma to Silva's clever pass and bursts away down the right.
He crosses for Haaland, but Areola once again denies City's number nine with tremendous reflexes.
That is now eight shots without success today for Haaland, though Areola has been in wonderful form to keep him at bay.
He will keep trying, though.
HAALAND!!! 3-1 CITY! Haaland gets his goal! Silva is found by Julian Alvarez in acres of space on the right.
The winger comes inside and picks out Haaland, who takes a touch before drilling past Areola.
Silva was afforded far too much space to come in from the right wing and pick out Haaland.
West Ham make two changes.
One of them sees Kehrer replace Coufal.
Ings is also introduced by Moyes with Soucek making way.
If at first you don't succeed, try, try and try again! That has certainly been the case for Haaland, whose patience and persistence eventually pays dividends.
Rodri goes into the book for tripping Kudus.
Doku is given a well-earned rest as he goes off to be replaced by Gomez.
We are into the first of six additional minutes at the end of this game.
City in complete control as the clock ticks down towards what should be a fifth straight victory.
The visitors neatly knock the ball around and maintain possession.
The visitors make a triple-change.
Haaland is given a breather with Lewis coming on.
Gvardiol also makes way for City, with Ake on for the final moments.
The last of the changes sees Bobb replace Silva.
Paqueta has his name taken for a trip on Bobb.
FULL-TIME: WEST HAM 1-3 MANCHESTER CITY
Manchester City stay perfect and return to the top of the Premier League table after coming from behind to beat West Ham 3-1.
The hosts took a first-half lead at the London Stadium through James Ward-Prowse's header.
But the visitors responded as Jeremy Doku levelled within 60 seconds of the restart.
Bernardo Silva then completed the turnaround in the 76th minute, before Erling Haaland sealed the points four minutes from time.
Both sides are in European action against Serbian opposition in midweek.
City launch their Champions League title defence against Red Star Belgrade on Tuesday, while West Ham begin their Europa League campaign against Backa Topola two days later.
That's all for today.
Thank you for joining us.
Until next time, goodbye!
